newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine to issue T-bills on February 6.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine to issue T-bills on February 6.

text.p: Ukraine's central bank will auction three-month, six-month, nine-month and 12-month discount treasury bills on February 6, a bank official said on Wednesday.
The issue volume of three-month T-bills was set at 15 million hryvnias, Vitaly Migashko, the head of the bank's market and exchange department, told Reuters.
The issue volume of six-month T-bills was set at 17 million hryvnias and of nine-month paper at 20 million hryvnias, while 22 million hryvnias' worth of 12-month T-bills will be issued.
